Container.Name: CoastGuarrd
Container.Overview: Watch tracking and safe library cleanup for Jellyfin, Seerr, Radarr, Sonarr and Lidarr. Tracks who watches what, where and on which devices, flags titles nobody watches, and moves them to a recycle bin that only you can empty. Nothing is ever deleted automatically.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the CoastGuarrd web interface.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Holds the encrypted database, its key file and poster backups.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The folder that contains ALL your media (and where recycle bins will be created). For Unassigned Devices drives use /mnt/disks/. The rw,slave mode lets the container see drives that are mounted after it starts.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are created as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are created as (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Used for watch times.

Config.Name: Database key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, a random key is created and stored in App data. If you set one, keep it safe — the database cannot be opened without it.
